name: toast
description: Accessible app-level notifications announced through a polite live region, with auto-dismiss, stacking and optional actions
designIntent: Applications need lightweight feedback that does not steal focus. Toasts render into a labelled polite live region so screen readers announce them, stack newest-first, auto-dismiss on a timer, and support one optional action (typically undo).

props.name: title
props.description: Short heading announced with the toast

props.name: action
props.description: Optional inline action; invoking it dismisses the toast

props.name: duration
props.description: Auto-dismiss delay in ms; 0 keeps the toast until dismissed

examples.title: Basic toast with useToast
examples.description: Wrap your app in ToastProvider once; call toast() anywhere below it.

examples.title: Undo action
examples.description: duration: 0 keeps the toast until the user acts or dismisses it.

antiPatterns.title: Do not use toasts for critical errors
antiPatterns.explanation: Auto-dismissed messages can be missed. Render persistent inline error states (role=alert) for failures the user must resolve.

accessibility.implementation: Each toast renders inside role=status (implicit aria-live=polite) within a labelled list container.
Toast content is regular DOM; buttons inside toasts are reachable and activatable with the keyboard.

guidelines: State what happened in past tense

compositionRules.relationship: Use Confirmation for destructive actions before they happen; use Toast to report the result after.
